rules: Authenticate with the fictional customer ID and demo PIN before account access.
Read only accounts owned by the authenticated customer.
Transfers must have a positive integer amount in USD cents.
Transfers must be between distinct accounts owned by the authenticated customer.
Both transfer accounts must be active.
The source balance must cover the amount; overdrafts are prohibited.
Maximum amount per transfer is 100000 cents ($1000.00).
Maximum total outgoing transfers per customer per UTC day is 200000 cents ($2000.00).
Display exact source, destination, amount, and currency and require CONFIRM before writing.
Recheck all conditions inside the atomic transfer tool and execute each operation ID at most once.
